'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[United States president]] [[Donald Trump]] confirms plans to sell weapons to [[NATO]] allies to be provided to [[Ukraine]] after [[United States Department of Defense|the Pentagon]] previously paused weapon shipments. [https://www.axios.com/2025/07/11/trump-ukraine-weapons-nato-allies-sell (Axios)] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/u-s-resumes-sending-some-weapons-to-ukraine-after-pentagon-pause (PBS)]
*[[Israeli settler violence]]
**[[Israeli settlers]] kill two [[Palestinians]] near [[Ramallah]] in the [[West Bank]]. One of the victims, identified as a [[Palestinian Americans|Palestinian-American]], was beaten to death whilst the other victim was shot in the chest. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-aware-reported-death-american-after-beating-by-israeli-settlers-2025-07-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**At least 23 civilians, including four children, are killed and about 30 others are injured, with ten critically injured, in an [[Myanmar Air Force|Air Force]] [[Airstrike|strike]] on a [[Buddhism|Buddhist]] [[monastery]] in the [[Sagaing District|District of Sagaing]], located in the [[Sagaing Region]] of [[Myanmar]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/23-dead-after-airstrike-buddhist-monastery-myanmar-123674107 (ABC News)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**At least five children are killed after an [[improvised explosive device|explosive device]] detonates in [[Al-Hashamah]], [[Taiz Governorate]], [[Yemen]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/12/at-least-five-children-killed-in-blast-in-southwest-yemen (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**[[Los Choneros]] gang leader [[José Adolfo Macías Villamar]] agrees to a request of [[Ecuador]]'s National Court for [[extradition]] to the [[United States]] to face trial for [[drug trafficking]] and [[arms smuggling]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/07/11/americas/ecuador-drug-fito-extradited-us-intl-latam (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/ecuador-gang-leader-fito-accepts-us-extradition-request-2025-07-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Ovidio Guzmán López]], son of the former drug lord [[Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán]], pleads guilty to two counts of [[drug trafficking|drug distribution]] and two counts of participation in a continuing [[organized crime|criminal enterprise]]. He is expected to cooperate with the U.S. government by providing information on criminal networks. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/el-chapos-son-ovidio-guzman-expected-plead-guilty-us-court-2025-07-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.chicagotribune.com/2025/07/11/son-of-el-chapo-guzman-to-plead-guilty/ (''Chicago Tribune'')]
